extension.description: Mirror and control your Android device from a VS Code side panel.
view.mirror.name: Device
command.selectDevice.title: Select Device
command.pause.title: Pause Mirroring
command.resume.title: Resume Mirroring
config.adbPath: Path to the `adb` executable. Leave empty to detect it automatically (PATH, `ANDROID_HOME`, Android SDK, Homebrew).
config.frameInterval: Screenshot mode: milliseconds to wait between captures.
command.showLog.title: Show Log
config.mode: How the screen is mirrored. `auto` uses scrcpy when it is installed and falls back to screenshots.
config.mode.scrcpy: Always use scrcpy (smooth H.264 video, real-time touch).
config.mode.screencap: Always use `adb screencap` (slow, needs only adb).
config.scrcpyServerPath: Path to the `scrcpy-server` file of an installed scrcpy. Leave empty to detect it (Homebrew, `/usr/share/scrcpy`, `SCRCPY_SERVER_PATH`).
config.maxSize: scrcpy: maximum video width or height in pixels (`0` = native resolution).
config.videoBitRate: scrcpy: video bit rate in bits per second.
